program_name: Bachelor of Business Administration (Hons) in Management

requirements.general: STPM Pass with a minimum Grade C (GPA 2.0) in any two (2) subjects and a pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level or its equivalent. A-Level Pass with a minimum Grade D in any two (2) subjects and a pass in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent. UEC Pass with a minimum Grade B in five (5) subjects and a pass in Mathematics and English. STAM Pass with a minimum Grade Jayyid and a pass in Mathematics and English at SPM level or its equivalent. Foundation / Matriculation Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Diploma / Advanced Diploma (Level 4/5, MQF) or Equivalent Pass with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Additional Notes A pass in Mathematics at the SPM level can be waived if the qualification contains an equivalent or higher achievement. Candidates without a pass in Mathematics or English at the SPM level (or equivalent) are required to attend special enhancement courses. English Language Requirements (for International Students) MUET: Minimum 4.0 IELTS: Minimum 5.5 TOEFL: Ess Online: Minimum 8 iBT: Minimum 46 Pearson: Minimum 51 Linguaskill: Minimum 160 OET: Minimum 200 ELS: Minimum 108 Exemptions International students with qualifications from educational systems where English is the primary medium of instruction are exempt from this requirement. Malaysian students' pass in English can be waived if previous studies were conducted in English or if they have at least Band 2 in Linguaskill. Alternative Option International students who do not fulfill the English Language Requirements may join the Intensive English Programme at Nilai University, which prepares them for the Linguaskill examination
